chapter: Italy and the future of New Orleans jazz
title: Not playing for three years and planning to go to Italy
summary: He last played in the symphony about three years ago, has only jammed blues since, and plans to move to Italy and play more.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: See? And how long has it been since you've played?
Oh, it's been about, I think it's been about three years since I last played.
And you haven't even sat in or?
Oh, I've jammed a few times. Yeah, I've jammed. A few blues and stuff like that. But in other words, I plan to pick it up when I go up to Italy.

Yeah. I'm leaving as soon as my boat comes in. Oh, well, yeah. Now, I expect to do a lot of playing in Italy. In fact, more than I've been doing over here. Because there is a lot more going on over there than there is over here, as far as the arts are concerned.
